subject.title: test harness follow-up: ui suite red with no CI lane, changed-gate typecheck gap, dead routing machinery, unenforced coverage thresholds

question: What permanent CI enforcement should this follow-up add for coverage thresholds and Node 22 compatibility?
rationale: The mechanical defects are established, but coverage scope and lower-bound runtime cadence set recurring CI capacity and maintenance cost; the protected maintainer label signals that this policy must be chosen before implementation.

options.title: Targeted scheduled enforcement
options.body: Gate relevant UI changes, run bounded coverage checks, and schedule Node 22 compatibility daily or weekly based on measured cost.

options.title: Remove dead guarantees
options.body: Delete unenforced coverage thresholds and document Node 22 as a manual release check rather than implying automatic enforcement.

options.title: Split policy follow-ups
options.body: Land the UI, typecheck, routing, and watchdog repairs first, then decide coverage and Node 22 in separate maintainer-owned issues.

recommendation.title: Targeted scheduled enforcement
recommendation.body: Gate relevant UI changes, run bounded coverage checks, and schedule Node 22 compatibility daily or weekly based on measured cost.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue and predecessor repair show direct recent ownership of the harness audit and the intentional deferral of these CI-policy decisions.
